scope: 概念插图，不代表设备实物；流程图另按源码绘制

assets.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Create a professional Chinese engineering textbook illustration for a Transport Unit software design document. Wide landscape 3:2, pure white background, precise restrained isometric technical rendering with subtle material shading, crisp typography. Explain a conceptual product hierarchy, NOT a real ZX2200 machine. Main subject: a flat neutral gray rectangular carrier containing exactly TWO green substrate boards side by side. Each substrate contains exactly THREE small blue rectangular islands arranged in one row. Each island contains exactly TWO small orange circular bond target points. Exploded magnification on the right shows one green substrate, below it one blue island with TWO orange target points enlarged. Use thin tidy leader lines and four readable Chinese labels verbatim: 'TU 载体', '基板 Substrate', '岛 Module', '焊点 BondPosition'. One short small footnote verbatim: '概念示意 非设备实物'. Layout airy, large objects and generous gaps, no UI cards, no decorative gears, no robot, no conveyors, no brand, no imaginary hardware, no dark backdrop. Render should communicate the nested hierarchy visually with physical parts and magnification, not a generic flowchart. All objects must respect exact 2 x 3 x 2 counts.

Use case: scientific-educational. Create a polished Chinese engineering manual illustration on a white background, wide 3:2 layout, elegant isometric rendering in green, blue, orange, gray. Subject is the relationship between a physical carrier product and its SOFTWARE runtime data, not a real machine. On the left show a small isometric neutral gray tray holding two green substrates, three blue islands per substrate and two orange bond target dots per island. Thin leader line from ONE orange dot connects to a large clean exploded fan of THREE translucent record sheets on the right. The top sheet has a precise crosshair and location glyph; middle sheet has three small completion checkmarks; bottom sheet has a height gauge glyph. Clear readable Chinese labels verbatim: over the tray '同一份产品'; top sheet '位置与定位'; middle sheet '工序进度'; bottom sheet '测高信息'. In a clear lower strip put a subtle conceptual two-stage comparison with small copies of the same tray: stage one label '点胶侧 S1', a single right arrow, stage two label '固晶侧 S2'. Exactly one small footer sentence '概念示意 数据变化以正文流程为准'. Do not claim steps or flags always preserved. Do not draw actual machine heads, belts, robots, factory environment, or pretend this is an actual hardware drawing. No generic connected rectangles, no UI dashboard, no decorative gradients, no branding. Composition should be a clean explanatory illustration, useful to a human reader seeing Transport Unit design for the first time. All Chinese text must be correct and not overlap.
assets.edit_prompt: Edit the supplied illustration. Preserve its composition, Chinese headings, colors, trays, three floating record sheets, and bottom two-stage overview. Correct only these technical issues: remove ALL numerical X/Y/theta values and height values from the record sheets, leaving the crosshair and height-gauge drawings, without any numeric text. On the middle 工序进度 sheet remove the three extra captions 点胶完成 固晶完成 检测完成 and connecting arrows; keep only three standalone small green check marks to symbolize records, with no implied fixed process ordering. Ensure every blue island on the LARGE LEFT tray has exactly TWO orange bond-target dots; both substrates must each have THREE blue islands. Preserve the existing exact footnote 概念示意 数据变化以正文流程为准. This is an educational concept picture, so do not introduce any new measurement values, labels, machine parts, or workflow claims.
